EPD p.7 A4 scenario:600km truck transport. A5 scenario:2% site material loss, packaging treatment and installation electricity0.02MJ/kg using European grid. This is the declared product installation scenario; whole-project temporary heat, site facilities, extra fixings and other site processes remain project inputs and must not be silently represented as zero.

The source supplies no separate A5.1 factor in this imported row; selecting A5 uses the full declared product-installation A5 scenario. Unimported lifecycle modules remain unavailable rather than zero.
